final: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg, o.weathprofile, t.telescregistry FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM linked), telescope_weather AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift FROM linked GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile), above AS (SELECT tw.weathprofile, tw.avg_modindex, tw.avg_phaseshift, tw.avg_modindex - overall.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM telescope_weather AS tw CROSS JOIN overall WHERE tw.avg_modindex > overall.overall_avg) SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(above_overall) AS avg_above_overall FROM above GROUP BY weathprofile
